answer: A cubic bond prices each operator’s whole key set. sable binds its keys to one vault across wallet rotation; pearl counts active keys and serializes admissions. A new key may trade only after crystal equal to the cube of its active-key rank is locked in that vault until retirement. The tenth key locks 1,000 crystal; ten concurrent keys keep 3,025 crystal locked, versus 1 for one honest key. No lock can back two keys, and fresh wallets cannot reset the count.
